## Review requirements

- [ ] A named human reviewer is requested (a person, not a team)
- [ ] A review-priority label is added (`review-priority:blocking`, `review-priority:important`, or `review-priority:can-wait`)
- [ ] The Linear issue is linked
- [ ] Exactly one `customer-impact` label is added (`customer-impact: none`, `customer-impact: low`, `customer-impact: medium`, or `customer-impact: high`)
- [ ] Low or above: an entry is added to this release's customer impact doc (the release owner's copy of the [Release Template](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1YugcHpUUNtJACMCli_nEFqXYBxTz1EirzWT2WB-6-Io/edit), named after the release)
